title: Distillation

concepts.def: Separation by boiling then cooling vapour back to liquid.
Separates a pure liquid from a solution.
Separates a mixture of liquids by different boiling points.
Apparatus that cools vapour back into liquid.
The temperature at which a liquid turns to vapour.
The pure liquid collected after distilling.

walkthroughs.body_html:
To separate water from a salt solution:

1) Heat the solution. Water boils at 100°C; salt does not.
2) Water vapour rises into the condenser.
3) Cold water around the condenser cools the vapour, turning it back to pure water.

Fractional distillation separates a mixture of liquids. The liquid with the lowest boiling point evaporates first and is collected first.

Used to separate crude oil!
Distillation makes fresh water from sea water in dry countries, separates alcohol from water, and turns crude oil into petrol, diesel and other useful fuels.
